name: 忍野ちよ🎨
description: Illustrator │ イラストご依頼受付中 │ 無断使用、二次配布、AI学習禁止 │ skeb https://skeb.jp/@Illoshino │ お問い合わせはDMもしくは illustoshino@gmail.com まで

works.body:
はじめまして。忍野ちよ様。
かほと申します。
アピールありがとうございます。

私のキャラクターは17歲。身長は154cmのJKです。
キャラクターの参考画像：
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1t1pO1XQOoU8loLCf87YROq03OksOQnBt/view?usp=sharing

ご自由に描いてください。
イラストは自分のSNSに使用します。
宜しくお願い致します。

アピールありがとうございます。
リクエストさせていただきたいと思います。

依頼内容ですが、是非ともアピールいただいた『雲の上で無重力状態でシャボン玉と一緒にふわふわしているイラスト』をお願いいたします。
服装などその他はおまかせいたします。

ゆゆにゃんは、シャボンで出来た猫耳と猫尻尾を持った黒髪ロングツインテールのJKです。 
シャボン玉や風船などのふわふわしたものが大好きな元気っ娘！という感じになります。 詳しくは、資料URLや送信したリクエストなどを参考にしていただければ幸いです。

あと、宛名についでですが、ゆゆにゃんへ、とさん付けなしでお願いいたします。

是非ともゆゆにゃんを描いていただきたく思います。
よろしくお願いいたします。

https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/111959321

Oshino chiyo-sama

Nice to meet you, my name is Hayachika, a VTuber.
Thank you for your appeal! I would like to request your illustration. It is very cute and I would like to commission it immediately! Thank you very much.

Clothing and pose
I usually only wear a hoodie, so I would be very happy if you could arrange it as you like and dress it up in a cute way.
The pose is also up to you. We would also appreciate it if you could make her look like a life-size standing picture.

Intended use
We would like to use the illustrations for posting on X (formerly Twitter), posting on the YouTube community, and as thumbnails and eye catchers on the delivery screen.
Therefore, if possible, we would appreciate it if you could provide us with the illustration and background in a psd format with separate layers.

Reference materials
Hayanochika
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1lLX3AJTGW7aUXkPyv8d2nb9eVXK_Unru
This is the history of the avatar by date. Basically, she is a red-haired, blue-eyed cat, so you can draw her as you like.

I would also like to monetize my YouTube channel when it becomes available, so this will be a commercial use. We would appreciate it if you could describe in a separate layer if there are any NG conditions regarding the use of the image.

We would be happy to accept your request. Thank you in advance.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1lLX3AJTGW7aUXkPyv8d2nb9eVXK_Unru

はじめまして けいすらと申します。
だいぶ前にアピールいただいておりましたが、今回 王様あお👑さん（@OsamaAo_V)というVTuberのイラストをお願いしたく、リクエストいたします。

彼女は設定上は王様ですので、既存のファンアートはカッコいい・クール・優雅な感じなイラストが多いのですが、
あえてかわいいに全振りした表情・ポーズ・構図でお願いしたいです。

上記以外の要望はございませんので、忍野ちよ様の感性にすべてお任せ致します。

なお、私の個人利用を超える範疇の利用として、王様あお👑ご本人がYouTubeやTwitter等で使用することを許容していただけると幸いです。

ご本人様のskebユーザページ

以上、よろしくお願いいたします

Hello,  I would like to accept your appeal. 
I would dearly like a wonderful artwork,  - featuring: Waltrud Krupinski (from Brave Witches).
I would love to see Waltrud wearing a dress similar to: https://twitter.com/ill_oshino/status/1698530127687438411/photo/1 .
I hope the dress can be blue - with lighter blue ribbons/trimmings - & with much shorter sleeves (shoulder coverage only), - perhaps a slightly shorter under-skirt part too.
I'd like Waltrud to be cheekily happy - with whatever pose you would prefer to do. 
I leave the background & other details to your discretion too (- with no text).
Thank-you so very much! 💕

Thank you very much!

Nice to meet you, and thank you very much for your very kind appeal.
I would very much like to request an illustration of my favorite Vtuber, Akua Mizuki (@mzsr_akua).
Since Chiyou Oshino-sama likes ribbons and frills, we would like to request Akua's April Fool's Day project costume. (We apologize that the hair color is red and white, which is a departure from the light blue and pink that you praised in your appeal.)
Please excuse the bullet points below.

Facial features and hair style...please refer to the reference image (1) in the URL below. If you have difficulty seeing the details of the costume, please check the attached URL from 34:36 to 39:12.
Pose, background, composition...We will leave it to you to draw what you are comfortable with.
Expression...I will leave it to you to draw what you are comfortable with, but if possible, a mischievous smiling expression would be nice.
Breasts...Please make them as modest as possible.
Usage...Tweets with Oshino Chiyo's name, ID, and FA tag "Nyahiart" (may be used as a thumbnail, etc.)
Other...We would appreciate it if you could deliver the image in psd or png format if possible.

Reference image (1)...https://i.imgur.com/jzM7eGu

I apologize for the length of this message.
We hope you will consider our proposal.

https://www.youtube.com/live/IZW0BLZY4c8
